signals.text: 1 open PM role across 3 US offices

bullets: Own the end-to-end merchant experience: from developer onboarding and API integration through payment operations, revenue reconciliation, dispute management, and merchant…
Own the developer platform roadmap: API design, documentation, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that reduce time-to-first-sale
Partner with engineering to design and ship platform integrations (Shopify, direct API, and emerging channels)
Serve as the voice of the merchant — synthesizing feedback from sales, merchant support, and direct merchant conversations into a prioritized roadmap
Define success metrics for merchant health (time to first sale, NRR, merchant NPS) and instrument the systems needed to track them
